reviewItem.question: Does "Added the `app.kubernetes.io/name`, `app.kubernetes.io/instance`, `app.kubernetes.io/part-of`, `app.kubernetes.io/version`, `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by`, and…" mean a change to compatibility-boundary:istio|name=kubernetes-recommended-labels (added)?

proposed.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds the Kubernetes recommended labels app.kubernetes.io/name, app.kubernetes.io/instance, app.kubernetes.io/part-of, app.kubernetes.io/version, app.kubernetes.io/managed-by, and helm.sh/chart to almost all resources.
